facts.title: squash toasts with ricotta and cider vinegar
ingredients: 1 2 1/2- to 3-pound kabocha or other yellow-fleshed squash
1/2 teaspoon dried chile flakes, more or less to taste
1 yellow onion, peeled and thinly sliced
1/2 cup (4 ounces) ricotta, goat cheese, feta or mascarpone
facts.yield_text: Serves 4 as a main, 8 as an appetizer. Takes about 45 minutes.
facts.author: Deb Perelman
